lg-6287e1911430: Pronunciation: /ʔahːi/, ah-hi. Start with short a. Sustain plain Arabic ه briefly, then make a clearly voiced short i vowel. The final kasra must be heard after the h; do not end in breath or ah. Keep i short, not long ee.
lg-bb2d966387ef: Pronunciation: /ʔaðːi/, adh-dhi. Start with short a, then doubled ذ, the voiced dental consonant with tongue at the teeth. Release into an audible short i. Preserve dental dh, not z or dz. Do not stop at the consonant.
lg-bfb39dc4a149: Pronunciation: /ʔafːi/, af-fi. Use an ordinary clean voiced short a onset, followed by doubled f and a short i vowel. Keep the onset smooth and free of creaking or growling. Say this single connected example once.
lg-c309be8fcad4: Pronunciation: /ʔaðˤːi/, aẓ-ẓi. Start with short a. Use doubled voiced emphatic Arabic ظ, then release into an audible short i. Keep voicing; do not substitute unvoiced ث. Do not finish on a sustained consonant.
lg-e52617263b32: Pronunciation: /ʔazːi/, az-zi. Start with short a, hold doubled z briefly, then release into a clearly voiced short i vowel. The final i must be audible after the z, not lost in a trailing buzz. Keep the vowel short.
